title: Reporting Bid Rigging
clause_text: This section outlines the process for reporting bid rigging activities. It specifically applies to bid rigging involving local government agencies and their employees, including those at the county, city, and school district levels. The intent is to provide a mechanism for identifying and addressing collusive bidding practices in public procurement.

title: Prohibited Official Actions Due to Financial Interest
clause_text: A public official at any level of state or local government shall not make, participate in making, or in any way attempt to use the public official's official position to influence a governmental decision in which the official knows or has reason to know that he or she has a financial interest. This clause, part of the Political Reform Act, aims to ensure impartiality in governmental decision-making by prohibiting officials from acting on matters where their personal financial interests are at stake.
